name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Octobox for triaging GitHub notifications with archiving, starring and filters, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign-in is through GitHub only. Register a GitHub OAuth app with homepage URL https://<your domain> and callback URL https://<your domain>/auth/github/callback, then set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET and redeploy.
Any GitHub user can sign in by default. To limit access, set RESTRICTED_ACCESS_ENABLED to true and fill GITHUB_ORGANIZATION_ID or GITHUB_TEAM_ID with the numeric ID.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
